literature_proposed.summary: This node is the middle range of Erdős-Lacampagne-Selfridge's Theorem 1: for k^(1+c) < n < k^(7/4) some prime p in (k/2, k) divides C(n,k). Published 1993 and not formalised. The proof is Ingham's short-interval prime count (deep, not in Mathlib) plus an elementary count of the primes in (k/2, k/2 + k^(7/8)) that have no multiple in (n - k, n]. A translation could split it into those two parts and prove the counting half outright.
